connectors.name: XLR (3-pin)
connectors.notes: Balanced audio. Outputs on equipment are male, inputs female.

connectors.name: XLR (5-pin)
connectors.notes: Standard for DMX512 lighting control.

connectors.name: 1/4" TS jack
connectors.notes: Unbalanced. Instrument and unbalanced line signals.

connectors.name: 1/4" TRS jack
connectors.notes: Balanced mono or unbalanced stereo. A TS plug fits a TRS socket (unbalanced).

connectors.name: Combo XLR/TRS
connectors.notes: Combined socket accepting XLR, TRS and TS plugs. Common on interface inputs.

connectors.name: 3.5mm TS minijack
connectors.notes: Modular synth patch connections: CV, gate, clock, audio.

connectors.name: 3.5mm TRS minijack
connectors.notes: Stereo minijack, also used for TRS MIDI on compact gear.

connectors.name: RCA
connectors.notes: Unbalanced line audio, phono, and coaxial S/PDIF.

connectors.name: MIDI DIN-5
connectors.notes: Standard MIDI in/out/thru.

connectors.name: USB-B
connectors.notes: Common device-side USB port on interfaces and synths.

connectors.name: micro-USB (B)
connectors.notes: Compact device-side USB port; often also the power inlet.

connectors.name: USB-C
connectors.notes: USB and Thunderbolt share this connector; check the port's signals.

connectors.name: TOSLINK optical
connectors.notes: Optical digital audio: ADAT (8ch) or S/PDIF (2ch) depending on the port.

connectors.name: BNC
connectors.notes: Word clock and video sync.

connectors.name: Coaxial aerial (IEC 169-2)
connectors.notes: The domestic TV aerial connector. Male on the cable, female on the set.

connectors.name: RJ45
connectors.notes: Network audio (Dante/AES67), control, and plain networking.

connectors.name: speakON NL4
connectors.notes: Locking speaker-level connector for passive PA.

connectors.name: IEC C14 inlet
connectors.notes: Mains inlet on equipment. Accepts a C13 cable end.

connectors.name: IEC C13 outlet
connectors.notes: Mains outlet form (on power distribution) and the cable end that feeds a C14 inlet.

connectors.name: IEC C8 inlet
connectors.notes: Ungrounded 2-pin mains inlet. Accepts a C7 (figure-8) cord.

connectors.name: IEC C7 plug
connectors.notes: The figure-8 cable end that feeds a C8 inlet.

connectors.name: IEC C6 inlet
connectors.notes: Grounded 3-pin mains inlet. Accepts a C5 (cloverleaf) cord.

connectors.name: IEC C5 plug
connectors.notes: The cloverleaf cable end that feeds a C6 inlet.

connectors.name: DC barrel
connectors.notes: External PSU input. Voltage and polarity vary, so check the device.
